mac init

#### 初始设置
```
#允许任何来源
sudo spctl --master-disable
#显示隐藏文件
defaults write com.apple.finder AppleShowAllFiles -boolean true;killall Finder
#不显示隐藏文件
defaults write com.apple.finder AppleShowAllFiles -boolean false;killall Finder
```

#### 安装 python git
```
/usr/bin/ruby -e "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/master/install)"
#brew 升级
brew update
#brew 清理旧包
brew cleanup
brew install wget
brew install python3
brew install git
```

#### git全局配置、测试
```
git config --global user.name "intcpu"
git config --global user.email "intcpu@foxmail.com"
ssh-keygen -t rsa -C "intcpu"
ssh -T git@github.com 
```

git filter-branch
#### git切换加密分支
```
rm -rf private
git clone git@github.com:intcpu/private.git
cd private
git switch config
echo '* filter=git-crypt diff=git-crypt' > .git/info/attributes
echo '.gitignore !filter !diff' >> .git/info/attributes
echo '.gitattributes !filter !diff' >> .git/info/attributes
git-crypt status
git-crypt unlock ../tmpfile 
sed $(($(sed -n '$=' .git/config)-6+1)),$(sed -n '$=' .git/config)d .git/config > tmp && cat tmp > .git/config && rm -f tmp
git-crypt status
git status
git add .
git commit -m 'decode'
git-crypt unlock ../tmpfile
git add .
git commit -m 'decode'
```


#### git加密配置
```
vim .git/config
[filter "fgc"]
smudge = /usr/local/bin/gpg -d -q --batch --no-tty
clean = /usr/local/bin/gpg -ea -q --batch --no-tty -r zhuanye
[filter "foc"]
smudge = openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -base64 -pass pass:intcpu198910231989!)@#_
clean = openssl enc -e -aes-256-cbc -base64 -pass pass:intcpu198910231989!)@#_

vim .git/info/attributes
*key* filter=fgc
*conf* filter=foc
```

#### gpg
```
#创建密钥
gpg --gen-key
#查私钥
gpg --list-secret-key
#gpg导出私钥
gpg -a -o zhuanye-sec.asc --export-secret-key EE86DA5C3836C53B0156BE76DA3BC7BD1AD55075
#导入私钥
gpg --import zhuanye-sec.asc

#查公钥
gpg --list-key
#gpg导出公钥
gpg -a -o zhuanye.asc --export 1A775FF619CBD55630ACBC6ECEBCB078131FD5E7
#导入公钥
gpg --import zhuanye.asc

#删私钥
gpg --delete-secret-keys 1A775FF619CBD55630ACBC6ECEBCB078131FD5E7
#删公钥
gpg --delete-keys 1A775FF619CBD55630ACBC6ECEBCB078131FD5E7
#全删 gpg --delete-secret-and-public-keys 1A775FF619CBD55630ACBC6ECEBCB078131FD5E7

#使用 zhuanye 的密钥对文件 file_1 进行加密
gpg -e -r zhuanye file_1
#使用 zhuanye 的密钥对文件 file_1 进行加密
gpg --passphrase=zhuanye -o file_1 -d file_1.gpg
```
